purpose: A checkbox with its visible label and an optional description in one row, where a click anywhere on the row toggles it. Use it on its own for terms and opt-ins, or as one row of a CheckboxGroup.

notFor.case: Several related options that need a shared question and one error message.
A labelled setting that applies immediately.
A row inside a table or list that already provides the label elsewhere.
Picking one option out of several.

Checked=false.visual: The nested Checkbox unchecked; label and description unchanged.

Checked=true.visual: The nested Checkbox checked; label and description unchanged.

Checked=indeterminate.meaning: Parent row of a partly checked list.
Checked=indeterminate.visual: The nested Checkbox indeterminate; label and description unchanged.

Disabled.meaning: The whole row cannot be changed.
Disabled.visual: Label and description Content/disabled; the box takes Checkbox Disabled.

Invalid.visual: Label Content/primary and description Content/secondary as Default; the box edge turns critical (Checkbox Invalid).

a11y.role: checkbox (the row is its <label>; the description is aria-describedby)
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the box (one tab stop). Space toggles it (Radix Checkbox). A click anywhere on the row toggles it.
notes: Size, Checked, State and Variant always match the nested Checkbox.
Hover and Focused belong to the nested Checkbox; the row has no state of its own for them.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis (Default · Disabled · Invalid) has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry. Should the label and description colours transition? (finding MOT-002 CheckboxItem)
A standalone CheckboxItem (terms) in Invalid has no slot for the error text. Where does the message go when there is no CheckboxGroup footer?
